name: What is the difference between general SEO and geo-targeted marketing for plastic surgeons?
description: General SEO targets broad visibility, while geo-targeted marketing focuses on attracting local patients within specific geographic areas.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between general SEO and geo-targeted marketing for plastic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: General SEO aims to improve overall website visibility across a broad audience, focusing on competitive national or international keywords. Geo-targeted marketing, a subset of SEO, specifically optimizes a practice's online presence to attract patients within defined geographic areas. While general SEO might target broad terms like 'breast augmentation,' geo-targeted marketing focuses on 'breast augmentation [city name]' to capture local search intent and draw patients from specific communities near the practice.
acceptedAnswer.description: General SEO targets broad visibility, while geo-targeted marketing focuses on attracting local patients within specific geographic areas.
